notes_for_editor: One source only: the TN Landforms list gives the name, county, coordinates, elevation and the code 'topo'. The name is the compiler's own label (entry 381 is above 73), and the page does not say what the 'topo' code means for this entry; the list's note says its map shows towers as discovered on 1:100,000 USGS topo maps and NGS data sheets, so the story does not claim the site rests on a map reading or on an agency record. Two searches and several reads found no history, build date, staffing, fate or access. A Forest Lookouts directory has a SAVANNAH entry in Chatham County with no history; it is not known to be this site. The brief's kind 'tower' comes from the list; nothing confirms a structure stood there. Status and access stay unknown. Check the USGS topo map and Georgia Forestry Commission records before publishing.
